product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides vision-AI-powered barcode, label and ID capture and shelf intelligence for enterprises and frontline workers in retail, logistics, transportation and healthcare.

pricing_page.notes: Publicly describes fixed and flexible pricing, annual subscriptions, and Core, Standard and Advanced editions; numerical prices require a quote.

eng_blog.notes: Two CTO-authored technical posts describe the Vision AI Engine’s models, codebase and on-device design, and how SparkScan’s scanning interface was built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Biometrics & Face Recognition), Tampere.

model_provider.notes: Scandit identifies its own engine and ML/VLM models; no named external model provider was identified in the documentation, security information, blog or subprocessor list.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001:2022 is certified; GDPR is claimed regulatory compliance, not a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest reported round was February 9, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Business Development Representative – French Speaker, London.

launched_6mo.notes: Self-Checkout Loss Prevention was announced September 15, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tom Karrat’s profile records his Scandit Chief Revenue Officer role starting January 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.
